title: SastEvaluationContract
description: Schema for heterogeneous LLM-as-a-Judge and static analysis evaluation output in Aethelgard Loop

judge_model_family.description: Identifier of the independent evaluator model family (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet, deepseek-r1)

generator_model_family.description: Identifier of the generator model (e.g. bonsai-27b-ternary, qwen-2.5-coder-7b)

gate_passed.description: True only if score >= 8.0 and critical_vulnerabilities_detected is false
